title: Quick Start
text: # Quick Start  MoonDocKit turns MoonBit package notes into a **small static documentation site**.  - parse front matter - render `HTML` pages - generate navigation - build a search index  ## Install  Add the package once it is published to mooncakes.io.  ## Generate  Use the library API to build an output manifest, then write every `OutputFile` to a destination directory. See the [MoonBit website](https://www.moonbitlang.com) for language documentation.

title: API Reference
text: # API Reference  The public API is built around a few small data models.  ## Pages  `DocPage` stores a source page with a title, slug, and Markdown body.  ## Routes  `plan_routes` reads page metadata and creates deterministic page paths.  ## Output  `build_site_manifest` returns generated files without touching the filesystem.

title: Changelog
text: # Changelog  ## 0.1.0  Initial competition baseline:  - block-level Markdown parsing - front matter parsing - table of contents generation - static output manifest - search index generation
